name: Brex
description: Handle your company’s deposits, payments, credit cards, spend management, and accounting in one place. Brex makes it refreshingly easy to see how your money’s being used and control how it’s spent.

events.d: Find users by email, name, or HR ID. Filter by status, manager, department, location, title, or custom fields.
Invite a new employee to Brex with name, email and optional team details.
Update a Brex user's status, manager, department, location, title or other details.
Issue a new virtual or physical Brex card for a user, with optional spend limits.
Unlock a locked Brex card so it can be used again.
Lock a Brex card to prevent use until unlocked. Requires card ID and reason; optional description.
Permanently terminate a Brex card by ID; select a reason and optional description.
Add a vendor in Brex with contact details and ACH, wire or check payment details.
Set or replace the memo on a Brex card expense.
Runs when a card expense is created or changed, with optional status filters.
Retrieve PAN, CVV, and expiration for a specific Brex card by card ID.
Get all Brex cards, optionally for one user, or fetch one card by its ID.
Get a Brex user by ID, or the user tied to your connection.
Get all Brex departments, optionally by name, or fetch one department by ID.
Get one location by ID or list locations, optionally filtering by name and limit.
Get all Brex titles, optionally by name, or fetch one title by ID.
Get all Brex cost centers, optionally by name, or fetch one cost center by ID.
Get all Brex legal entities or fetch one legal entity by ID.
Get the Brex company linked to your connection.
Retrieve all cash accounts with balances, or fetch a single cash account by ID.
Get all Brex card accounts with balances and limits.
Get finalized statements for the primary card account or a chosen cash account.
Get settled card transactions, optionally for chosen users and from a start date.
Retrieve transactions from a selected cash account, optionally filtered by a posted-after date or result limit.
Get Brex expenses with filters such as user, status and dates, or fetch one expense by ID.
Get all Brex vendors, optionally by name, or fetch one vendor by ID.
